name: yt-live-chat-overlay
description: Nico-nico style comment overlay for YouTube live chat (100% local processing)

scripts.quality: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm -s fmt:fix && pnpm -s lint:fix && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip
scripts.validate:consistency: cd test && npx vitest run consistency/
scripts.build:extension: vite build --config vite.config.extension.ts && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.ts && cp extension/manifest.json dist-extension/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension/
scripts.build:extension:dev: vite build --config vite.config.extension.ts --mode development && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.ts --mode development && cp extension/manifest.json dist-extension/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension/
scripts.build:extension:firefox: vite build --config vite.config.extension.firefox.ts && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.firefox.ts && cp extension/manifest.firefox.json dist-extension-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension-firefox/

author: PiesP
